llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store hook is created with `create` from `zustand`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Store is created with `create` imported from 'zustand' and exported as `useFeedStore`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action calls `set` to write loading state before awaiting network work
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `set({ status: 'loading', error: null })` is called synchronously before the `await fetch(...)` call.
evidence: feedStore.ts: set({ status: 'loading', error: null }) immediately before await fetch(...)

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action writes success data and error state through `set` in separate branches
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: try branch calls `set({ status: 'success', items })` and catch branch calls `set({ status: 'error', items: [], error: message })` separately.
evidence: feedStore.ts: set({ status: 'success', items }) in try
feedStore.ts: set({ status: 'error', items: [], error: message }) in catch

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Error UI retry trigger calls the same async store action used by initial fetch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The Retry Pressable in the error UI calls `onPress={fetchFeed}` which is the same `fetchFeed` action from the store used for the initial fetch.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI output branches by lifecycle status values for idle loading success and error
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `statusContent` object maps all four lifecycle values ('idle', 'loading', 'success', 'error') to distinct React nodes, rendered via `statusContent[status]`.
evidence: App.tsx: statusContent satisfies Record<FeedStatus, React.ReactNode> with idle/loading/success/error keys
